## Objective

Deliver the complete first release of project-owned Sys4AI memory defined by TRD-20260908-7BA638D7 revision 2, with core, workflow integration, reusable/Template/initializer delivery, explicit active-root adoption and a conditional local Basic Memory pilot.

User value: Users and agents retain useful evidence-backed project lessons and research context while current sources, execution ownership, project isolation and observed verification retain authority.

### Success outcomes

- Canonical records remain portable, scoped, attributable and directly readable without a backend.
- Frozen memory informs existing native Task/role workflows without changing their schema, teams, ownership or read-only behavior.
- Complete reusable assets and empty starters reach the Template/new-project fixtures; active root adoption preserves local policy and existing-product state.
- The pinned local pilot produces actual isolation/preservation/retrieval/operational evidence and conditional enablement; failures preserve fallback.
- All 59 requirements and every changed artifact have current classified evidence with actual native and integrated validation.

## Scope

### In scope

- A portable project-local Markdown memory contract, validated configuration, selective capture, lifecycle, provenance, retrieval, publication, concurrency, and recovery.
- Distinct retrieval of curated memories and permitted Markdown, TeX, PDF, and HTML source documents, with a deterministic lexical/direct-read fallback and a bounded Basic Memory pilot.
- Existing Task, Agent Task, role-management, Project Director, Task Manager, and general sub-agent integration, including frozen memory inputs for independent solvers and U03's publication policy.
- Reusable assets in `MEMORY-depo/`, `SKILLS-depo/`, and the applicable existing guidance/role/specification collections; their complete publication through the Template pipeline.
- Empty memory starter selection, identity specialization, setup-edition compatibility, and preservation behavior in the initializer. Disposable new-project and existing-project fixtures are in scope for verification.
- Explicit adoption into `/Volumes/P-SSD/AngryOwl/Sys4AI`, preserving its installed policies and project-owned files. Basic Memory adoption is conditional on the pilot evidence.

### Out of scope

- Cognee, a research-graph backend, and a generalized framework for multiple retrieval backends.
- Adoption, provisioning, or migration in any existing product project. Existing-project preservation is verified using disposable fixtures, not an unselected product.
- Restoring the retired Memory Service or ontology system, recovering their data, or creating an ontology service. Links to an independently adopted vocabulary remain compatible with the memory contract.
- A global memory namespace, automatic cross-project imports, transcript capture, session-history archives, a second execution ledger, a scheduler, or a mandatory memory-manager role.
- Cloud routing, cloud synchronization, hosted embedding services, editor requirements, or additional harness integrations as first-release deliverables. The pilot uses a local profile; separately requested external integrations remain separate work.
- The current planning operation performs none of the planned implementation, runtime/model provisioning, memory publication, Task state mutation, Git, deployment or product-adoption actions.

### Execution authority

This invocation authorizes only creation and validation of a managed implementation-plan draft. Plan creation, tracking, source approval and readiness do not themselves authorize implementation, Task creation/execution, memory publication, installation, model download, MCP registration, Git/publication/deployment or other separately governed actions. Future execution must be separately authorized for the exact plan through the applicable project workflow.

### Constraints

- Preserve every original REQ-001 through REQ-059 outcome, acceptance statement and dependency. Internal choices are proposed and attributable to approved TRD D04/D05.
- Only this managed plan and its generated catalog/projections are written during planning. The project Task ledger and TRD lifecycle remain read-only.
- Future execution requires the exact reviewed plan and applicable project Task/manager workflow; installation, model provisioning, MCP settings and external actions retain their own scope.
- Author reusable assets in source collections, publish only the registered Template through the updater, and apply a separately inspected exact root adoption manifest.
- The root Python .venv and Task/role standard-library independence are preserved; optional extraction and pilot dependencies have distinct manifests/runtimes.
- Historical source/Task/plan/role records, unselected products, unrelated edits, licenses and factual registry remain protected. Execution-owned new Task/plan evidence uses its existing helpers, not a competing ledger.
- No parallel-group is asserted because multiple tasks share helper/guidance paths. A confirmed execution manager can schedule only observed-safe nonoverlapping work with the required category teams.
- Backend/read-only/native compatibility is a planned empirical gate, not a baseline evidence gap. Failed or unexercised mandatory behaviors remain explicit; the negative pilot path preserves lexical/direct use.
- No product registration is performed for disposable verification: initializer fixtures run in isolated mirrored depots. A real root pilot remains bounded to allowed root corpus after isolated safety checks.
- Do not restore retired ontology/Memory Service or infer native/semantic readiness from old memories or passing static fixtures.

## Decisions

| Decision | Status | Statement | Authority |

| `DEC-001` | `approved` | Retain the complete first-release scope and exclusions in TRD U02/D01; disposable fixtures cover preservation and isolation without adopting an actual existing product. | The designated approved TRD revision 2 records U02 and D01; this preserves its source decision and grants no execution authority. |
| `DEC-002` | `approved` | Use the delegated per-note approval policy in TRD U03/D02: the Director or confirmed manager can activate evidence-backed notes only within its current granted memory scope. | The designated approved TRD revision 2 explicitly records U03; plan creation neither grants this runtime scope nor publishes a memory. |
| `DEC-003` | `approved` | Keep backend enablement conditional on all mandatory compatibility checks; a negative/incomplete pilot preserves fallback and is never a successful backend adoption. | Approved TRD D03 and REQ-053; no alternative backend is authorized. |
| `DEC-004` | `proposed` | Use Python 3.12 standard-library core validation with JSON-compatible YAML objects for memory.yaml and record frontmatter. Reject unsupported YAML constructs explicitly; do not add a general YAML parser to Task or role runtimes. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-005` | `proposed` | Keep learned records only under owning MEMORY/. Publish MEMORY-depo contract assets to reference-assets/MEMORY-depo in Template and adopt that same relative contract location into the active root. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-006` | `proposed` | Use durable memory-only transaction journals under .sys4ai/memory/maintenance/ with expected pre/post hashes, atomic record writes and idempotent recovery. Keep projection, normalization and index directories rebuildable; backend-config and unresolved journals are not caches. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-007` | `proposed` | Use a derived Basic Memory projection and a fixed permitted-query adapter. Do not expose vendor mutation tools to children or round-trip vendor metadata into canonical records. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-008` | `proposed` | Pilot basic-memory==0.23.0 with local FastEmbed bge-small-en-v1.5 and SQLite in .venv-memory-pilot. Freeze full dependency and immutable model artifacts before provisioning; retain exact-version metadata and license evidence. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-009` | `proposed` | Use optional PyMuPDF extraction declared in memory-owned requirement files. Record root .venv PyMuPDF 1.28.2 explicitly during adoption while keeping Basic Memory dependencies out of root .venv and all Task/role imports. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-010` | `proposed` | Use existing artifact.register, baseline.inputs and assignment context path/hash references for immutable memory packets. Enforce same-packet and sibling rules in memory integration without modifying the Task schema. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-011` | `proposed` | Introduce governance-starter-v5 with edition-specific memory requirements and specialization, while preserving v1-v4 requirements, licensing and saved-receipt rerun behavior. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-012` | `proposed` | Stage reusable work under coordinated watcher control, publish the complete Template first, then apply a separately inspected exact root adoption manifest with persistent semantic use disabled until pilot pass. | Proposed implementation choice within approved TRD D04/D05; included in this draft for exact-revision plan review. |
| `DEC-013` | `proposed` | Use disposable mirrored depots for initializer/native fault scenarios because the initializer derives its owning depot from its installation.
